name: renderpresets-simple
description: Simple rung for the renderPresets flag (IXT-SUITES batch 6): tier:'simple', default-on 'Render preset' select in the toolbar Scene menu. Opens the real Scene menu, asserts the select mounts (hides when force-disabled, reappears when re-enabled), then applies the 'Bright day' preset's underlying store actions (the same 4 setters SceneMenu's onChange calls) and asserts time/tone/exposure/lights all land.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); })()

steps.name: scene-menu-open
steps.failMessage: 'Render preset' select should be present in Simple mode (renderPresets is tier:simple, default:true)

steps.name: assert-select-hidden
steps.failMessage: 'Render preset' select should disappear once renderPresets is force-disabled

steps.name: assert-select-restored
steps.failMessage: 'Render preset' select should reappear once renderPresets is re-enabled

steps.name: baseline-not-bright-day
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); if (s.manualHour === 12 && s.toneMapping === 'neutral' && s.exposure === 1.1 && s.lightsMode === 'off') throw new Error('Store already matches Bright day preset before applying it — baseline check is meaningless'); })()

steps.name: apply-bright-day-preset
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setPresetTime('noon'); s.setToneMapping('neutral'); s.setExposure(1.1); s.setLightsMode('off'); })()

steps.name: assert-preset-applied
steps.failMessage: Applying the Bright day render preset's actions did not land in the store
